#phase metrics
```{r}
# Step 0. IO

cell_out_dir <- "/Users/zhangqian/scRhythmBayes/data/Benchmark/benchmark_cell_number_4000g_6tp"
timepoint_out_dir <- "/Users/zhangqian/scRhythmBayes/data/Benchmark/benchmark_timepoint_number_4000g_20000c"

cell_param_long_dir <- file.path(cell_out_dir, "param_long")
cell_truth_dir <- file.path(cell_out_dir, "truth_params")

timepoint_param_long_dir <- file.path(timepoint_out_dir, "param_long")
timepoint_truth_dir <- file.path(timepoint_out_dir, "truth_params")

metric_dir <- file.path(cell_out_dir, "gene_param_metrics")
plot_dir <- file.path(cell_out_dir, "plots_gene_param")

dir.create(metric_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cell_number_vec <- c(600, 1500, 3000, 6000, 10500, 20000)
n_repeat <- 1

CELL_NUMBER_ORDER <- c(600, 1500, 3000, 6000, 10500, 20000)

CELL_NUMBER_COLORS <- c(
  "600"   = "#2F6F73",
  "1500"  = "#357090",
  "3000"  = "#3a621f",
  "6000"  = "#17441e",
  "10500" = "#57ADDE",
  "20000" = "#A8C7E6"
)

CELL_NUMBER_LABELS <- c(
  "600"   = "600",
  "1500"  = "1,500",
  "3000"  = "3,000",
  "6000"  = "6,000",
  "10500" = "10,500",
  "20000" = "20,000"
)

LINE_COLOR <- CELL_NUMBER_COLORS["20000"]

amp_phase_min <- 0.1

# Step 1. Helper functions

rad_to_hour <- function(x) {
  ((as.numeric(x) %% (2 * pi)) / (2 * pi)) * 24
}

circ_diff_hour <- function(truth, pred) {
  ((as.numeric(pred) - as.numeric(truth) + 12) %% 24) - 12
}

# Step 2. Load phase truth and prediction

load_phase_one_cell_number <- function(target_n_cell, rep_id = 1) {

  if (target_n_cell == 20000) {
    param_long_rds <- file.path(
      timepoint_param_long_dir,
      paste0("param_long_timepoint6_rep", rep_id, ".rds")
    )

    truth_file <- file.path(
      timepoint_truth_dir,
      "truth_params_timepoint6_4000g_20000c.rds"
    )

    actual_n_cell <- 20000
    source_benchmark <- "timepoint_number_6tp_20000c"
  } else {
    param_long_rds <- file.path(
      cell_param_long_dir,
      paste0("param_long_cell", target_n_cell, "_rep", rep_id, ".rds")
    )

    truth_file <- file.path(
      cell_truth_dir,
      paste0("truth_params_cell", target_n_cell, "_4000g_6tp.rds")
    )

    actual_n_cell <- target_n_cell
    source_benchmark <- "cell_number"
  }

  stopifnot(file.exists(param_long_rds))
  stopifnot(file.exists(truth_file))

  param_long <- readRDS(param_long_rds)
  truth_i <- readRDS(truth_file)

  genes_truth <- as.character(truth_i$genes)
  groups_truth <- as.character(truth_i$groups)

  truth_phase_df <- expand.grid(
    gene = genes_truth,
    Group = groups_truth,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(
      gene_index = match(gene, genes_truth),
      group_index = match(Group, groups_truth),
      truth_phase = rad_to_hour(truth_i$phi_mat[cbind(gene_index, group_index)]),
      truth_amp = truth_i$A_mat[cbind(gene_index, group_index)]
    ) %>%
    select(gene, Group, truth_phase, truth_amp)

  param_long %>%
    transmute(
      gene = as.character(gene),
      Group = as.character(condition),
      pred_phase = rad_to_hour(Phase),
      pred_amp = as.numeric(Amplitude),
      target_n_cell = target_n_cell,
      actual_n_cell = actual_n_cell,
      repeat_id = rep_id,
      source_benchmark = source_benchmark
    ) %>%
    left_join(truth_phase_df, by = c("gene", "Group")) %>%
    select(
      gene, Group,
      truth_amp, pred_amp,
      truth_phase, pred_phase,
      target_n_cell, actual_n_cell,
      repeat_id, source_benchmark
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      truth_amp = as.numeric(truth_amp),
      pred_amp = as.numeric(pred_amp),
      truth_phase = as.numeric(truth_phase),
      pred_phase = as.numeric(pred_phase)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(truth_amp),
      is.finite(pred_amp),
      is.finite(truth_phase),
      is.finite(pred_phase),
      truth_amp > amp_phase_min
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      phase_error = circ_diff_hour(truth_phase, pred_phase),
      abs_phase_error = abs(phase_error)
    )
}

# Step 3. Merge all cell-number inputs

phase_all <- list()
run_id <- 1

for (target_n_cell in cell_number_vec) {
  for (rep_id in seq_len(n_repeat)) {
    message("Loading phase result | target_n_cell = ", target_n_cell, " | repeat = ", rep_id)

    phase_all[[run_id]] <- load_phase_one_cell_number(
      target_n_cell = target_n_cell,
      rep_id = rep_id
    )

    run_id <- run_id + 1
  }
}

phase_long <- bind_rows(phase_all) %>%
  mutate(
    target_n_cell = factor(as.character(target_n_cell), levels = as.character(CELL_NUMBER_ORDER)),
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("cond_1", "cond_2"))
  )

print(head(phase_long))
print(table(phase_long$target_n_cell))
print(table(phase_long$Group))
print(table(phase_long$source_benchmark))
print(summary(phase_long$truth_amp))
print(colSums(is.na(phase_long)))

stopifnot(
  all(!is.na(phase_long$truth_amp)),
  all(!is.na(phase_long$pred_amp)),
  all(!is.na(phase_long$truth_phase)),
  all(!is.na(phase_long$pred_phase))
)

write_tsv(
  phase_long,
  file.path(metric_dir, "Phase_truth_pred_long_cell_number.tsv")
)

write_csv(
  phase_long,
  file.path(metric_dir, "Phase_truth_pred_long_cell_number.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  phase_long,
  file.path(metric_dir, "Phase_truth_pred_long_cell_number.rds")
)

# Step 4. Metrics

metrics_phase <- phase_long %>%
  group_by(target_n_cell, actual_n_cell, repeat_id) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    ME = mean(phase_error),
    MAE = mean(abs_phase_error),
    MSE = mean(phase_error^2),
    RMSE = sqrt(mean(phase_error^2)),
    MAPE = mean(abs_phase_error / 12) * 100,
    R = cor(truth_phase, pred_phase, method = "pearson"),
    R2 = R^2,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    target_n_cell = factor(as.character(target_n_cell), levels = as.character(CELL_NUMBER_ORDER))
  )

print(metrics_phase)

write_csv(
  metrics_phase,
  file.path(metric_dir, "Phase_metrics_summary_cell_number_all_repeats.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  metrics_phase,
  file.path(metric_dir, "Phase_metrics_summary_cell_number_all_repeats.rds")
)

# Step 5. Median summary across repeats

metrics_phase_median <- metrics_phase %>%
  group_by(target_n_cell) %>%
  summarise(
    actual_n_cell = median(actual_n_cell, na.rm = TRUE),
    N = median(N, na.rm = TRUE),
    ME = median(ME, na.rm = TRUE),
    MAE = median(MAE, na.rm = TRUE),
    MSE = median(MSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    RMSE = median(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    MAPE = median(MAPE, na.rm = TRUE),
    R = median(R, na.rm = TRUE),
    R2 = median(R2, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_repeat = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    target_n_cell_num = as.numeric(as.character(target_n_cell)),
    target_n_cell = factor(as.character(target_n_cell), levels = as.character(CELL_NUMBER_ORDER))
  ) %>%
  arrange(target_n_cell_num)

print(metrics_phase_median)

write_csv(
  metrics_phase_median,
  file.path(metric_dir, "Phase_metrics_summary_cell_number_median.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  metrics_phase_median,
  file.path(metric_dir, "Phase_metrics_summary_cell_number_median.rds")
)

# Step 6. Long format for plotting

metrics_phase_long <- metrics_phase_median %>%
  select(target_n_cell, target_n_cell_num, ME, MAE, MSE, RMSE, MAPE, R2) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(ME, MAE, MSE, RMSE, MAPE, R2),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    metric = factor(metric, levels = c("ME", "MAE", "MSE", "RMSE", "MAPE", "R2")),
    target_n_cell = factor(as.character(target_n_cell), levels = as.character(CELL_NUMBER_ORDER)),
    label = case_when(
      metric == "MAPE" ~ sprintf("%.1f%%", value),
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", value)
    )
  )

write_csv(
  metrics_phase_long,
  file.path(metric_dir, "Phase_metrics_long_cell_number.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  metrics_phase_long,
  file.path(metric_dir, "Phase_metrics_long_cell_number.rds")
)

# Step 7. Single metric plots

plot_phase_metric_line <- function(metric_use, title, ylab, out_name) {

  df_plot <- metrics_phase_long %>%
    filter(metric == metric_use) %>%
    mutate(
      target_n_cell = factor(as.character(target_n_cell), levels = as.character(CELL_NUMBER_ORDER))
    )

  p <- ggplot(
    df_plot,
    aes(x = target_n_cell, y = value, group = 1)
  ) +
    geom_line(
      color = LINE_COLOR,
      linewidth = 1.35,
      alpha = 0.85
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(fill = target_n_cell),
      shape = 21,
      size = 5.6,
      color = "black",
      stroke = 0.35,
      alpha = 1
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = label),
      vjust = ifelse(df_plot$value >= 0, -1.15, 1.45),
      size = 6.2,
      fontface = "bold",
      family = "serif"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = CELL_NUMBER_COLORS,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = CELL_NUMBER_LABELS) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.22, 0.42))) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Number of cells",
      y = ylab
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14, base_family = "serif") +
    theme(
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(30, 32, 32, 32),
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 28, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 17, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 19, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )

  print(p)

  ggsave(
    file.path(plot_dir, paste0(out_name, ".pdf")),
    p,
    width = 7.2,
    height = 6.0
  )

  ggsave(
    file.path(plot_dir, paste0(out_name, ".png")),
    p,
    width = 7.2,
    height = 6.0,
    dpi = 300
  )

  p
}

p_phase_me <- plot_phase_metric_line(
  "ME",
  "Phase ME",
  "ME (hours)",
  "Phase_ME_cell_number_lineplot"
)

p_phase_mae <- plot_phase_metric_line(
  "MAE",
  "Phase MAE",
  "MAE (hours)",
  "Phase_MAE_cell_number_lineplot"
)

p_phase_mse <- plot_phase_metric_line(
  "MSE",
  "Phase MSE",
  "MSE",
  "Phase_MSE_cell_number_lineplot"
)

p_phase_rmse <- plot_phase_metric_line(
  "RMSE",
  "Phase RMSE",
  "RMSE (hours)",
  "Phase_RMSE_cell_number_lineplot"
)

p_phase_mape <- plot_phase_metric_line(
  "MAPE",

# Step 8. Facet plot

metrics_phase_plot <- metrics_phase_long %>%
  filter(metric %in% c("ME", "MAE", "MSE", "RMSE", "MAPE", "R2")) %>%
  mutate(
    metric = factor(as.character(metric), levels = c("ME", "MAE", "MSE", "RMSE", "MAPE", "R2")),
    target_n_cell = factor(as.character(target_n_cell), levels = as.character(CELL_NUMBER_ORDER))
  )

p_phase_facet <- ggplot(
  metrics_phase_plot,
  aes(x = target_n_cell, y = value, group = 1)
) +
  geom_line(
    color = LINE_COLOR,
    linewidth = 1.15,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = target_n_cell),
    shape = 21,
    size = 4.6,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.35,
    alpha = 1
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = CELL_NUMBER_COLORS,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = CELL_NUMBER_LABELS) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ metric,
    scales = "free_y",
    nrow = 2
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Phase prediction metrics across cell numbers",
    x = "Number of cells",
    y = "Value"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14, base_family = "serif") +
  theme(
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(12, 14, 22, 14),
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 24, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    panel.spacing = grid::unit(1.2, "lines"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_phase_facet)

ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, "Phase_metrics_cell_number_facet_lineplot.pdf"),
  p_phase_facet,
  width = 11,
  height = 7.5
)

ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, "Phase_metrics_cell_number_facet_lineplot.png"),
  p_phase_facet,
  width = 11,
  height = 7.5,
  dpi = 300
)

message("Finished cell-number phase metric calculation and plotting.")
message("Metric output: ", metric_dir)
message("Plot output: ", plot_dir)
```
